snippet.title: Corebreaker - Early Access Launch Trailer | Steam PC
snippet.description:
Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

Expect snappy controls, satisfying gunplay, and epic boss fights — all at an accessible entry price that makes it easy to jump in early and help shape what comes next.

Check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190920
